verdict.rationale: Trivy is a security scanning tool/CLI, not an AI agent or orchestrator that would consume other MCP servers' tools; the evidence shows Trivy instead ships an MCP *server* (trivy-mcp) that exposes Trivy's own scanning capabilities to external AI clients like VS Code — the opposite direction from 'plugging MCP servers into Trivy so it can use their tools.' This client-side consumption axis is a category error for a scanner product.
